student: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14, identical original checkpoint in all runs
initialization: Official randomly initialized heads; no published CIRR or MagicLens fine-tuned student weights
objective: Original CLIP-L OPRD: reverse KL, T=0.05, student top32 each epoch, force target, no teacher filtering
optimizer: 4 epochs, batch32, AdamW head1e-5/backbone5e-7, seed42, bf16
preprocessing: Identical original HF CLIP preprocessing in all three experiments; this is an exact head architecture ablation on one backbone, not a reproduction of the full pretrained external systems
evaluations: QDiag all and ADD/SUBSTITUTE/DELETE, hierarchical aggregation and bootstrap2000 seed42
selection: Fixed epoch4, no QDiag checkpoint selection
